placeKinds:
City Pantry Formula (25-30 places):

Daily Routine (repeat across neighborhoods):
- 3 bars/cafés - morning coffee, daily touchpoint
- 2 bakeries - bread, pastries, morning routine

Food & Shopping (vocabulary contexts):
- 2-3 markets - produce, local food, vendors
- 2 restaurants - sit-down, regional dishes
- 1-2 specialty food - city-specific (e.g., pizzeria, osteria, trattoria)

Cultural/Landmark (2-4 places):
- 1 major landmark (iconic)
- 1-2 churches/cultural sites
- 1 park or public garden
- 1-2 piazzas (social gathering)

Social/Evening (1-2 each):
- Wine bars or aperitivo spots (enoteca, wine bar)
- Bookshop or cultural shop

Practical (1-2 total):
- Pharmacy, neighborhood shop
- Transportation hub if relevant

City Character (2-3 unique):
Reflect what makes this city special
placePrompt: Soft pastel sketch on white paper of [the place]. [Colours, light, mood]. Warm colors, textured, inviting.
portraitPrompt: Pen and ink portrait on white paper of [the person]. Minimal watercolor wash in [a few colours]. Detailed linework, personal. The subject is a [woman/man].

placeStyles.roma-nuova: Fine-line pen drawing on white paper, precise thin black lines, flat light colour fills

placeRules: No other words anywhere: no dates, no neighbourhood or city names, no slogans, no prices, no brand names or logos. Contemporary Italy: today's clothes and objects, everyday life. Keep the main scene in the centre; nothing important near the edges.
placeStylesNote: Roma nuova (2026-10-22, docs/rome-redo.md): place prompt = city style + scene + its name as the only sign + placeRules (scripts/lib/place-prompt.mjs), as Mexico does. Cities without a style keep their full imagePrompt.
